## 🧱 Type of Change

<!-- Check all that apply. -->
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update (README, comments, etc.)
- [ ] 🧹 Refactor / cleanup (no functional changes)
- [ ] 🏗️ Build / infra (CI, tooling, dependencies)
- [ ] 🎨 Styling / UI (CSS, Tailwind, assets)

---

## 📋 Related Issues

<!-- Link any issues this PR closes or addresses. -->
- Closes #<issue-number>
- Related to #<issue-number>

---

## ✅ Checklist

<!-- Please confirm before requesting review. -->
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines (Tailwind, TypeScript conventions)
- [ ] `npm run lint` / type-check passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build succeeds locally (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Dev server runs without errors (`npm run dev`)
- [ ] Self-review completed — no leftover `console.log`, debug code, or TODOs
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated (README, inline comments)
- [ ] No new secrets, credentials, or `.env` files committed (see `.gitignore`)
